name: benalloway-dot-com
description: Personal wiki, Plex-portable movie collection, and articles — benalloway.com (Astro 7 + Cloudflare Workers + Tailwind CSS v4)

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c dist/server/wrangler.json --domain benalloway.com --domain www.benalloway.com
scripts.forge:gh: gh workflow run forge.yml && sleep 2 && gh run watch
scripts.forge:gh:pr: gh workflow run forge.yml -f delivery=pr && sleep 2 && gh run watch

author: Ben Alloway
